<issue>
Core properties title getter returns modified value instead of original

#### Description

The `title` property getter in `CorePropertiesPart` is unexpectedly modifying the title text by stripping whitespace and converting to lowercase, rather than returning the original value as stored.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pptx import Presentation

# Create a new presentation
prs = Presentation()

# Set a title with mixed case and whitespace
prs.core_properties.title = "  My Presentation Title  "

# Get the title back - should return original value
print("Expected: '  My Presentation Title  '")
print(f"Actual: '{prs.core_properties.title}'")
```

The title getter should return the exact value that was set, but instead returns a modified version with stripped whitespace and lowercase conversion.
</issue>
